result:
The proposed answer of 1/22 does not match what I recall of the Konyagin–Shkredov result, so I am rejecting it. I could not check this against the paper, so the rejection rests on memory.

I recall the abstract stating that if ‖exp(−2πizφ)‖_{A(𝕋)} = O(log^{1/12−ε}|z|) for some ε > 0, then φ must be affine. That form, with an exponent written as c − ε, matches the problem statement and gives c = 1/12.

The proposed solution instead gives a hypothesis with exponent γ < 1/22. I do not recall 1/22 as the exponent in the published theorem.

VERDICT: REJECT
